sections.title: CSV configuration
sections.body:
The supplied configuration selects CSV exports, sets a maximum of 1,000 rows, and selects reject as the overflow policy. These are configuration values, not proof of an executed export.

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Format | CSV |
| Maximum rows | 1,000 |
| Overflow policy | Reject |

qa.question: What should I check when an export exceeds the limit?
qa.answer: Confirm the requested row count against the 1,000-row configuration limit. The fixture selects rejection, but the actual error response, retry behavior and user-facing message have not been tested. Do not change production limits based on this example.

miscellaneous_qa.question: Does this example establish production readiness?
miscellaneous_qa.answer: No. It documents a synthetic configuration snapshot. Runtime behavior and deployment acceptance remain untested.

gaps.next_action: Run an authorized functional test against the intended environment.
